name: PILATE
canonical: Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea, a clean-shaven Roman man of middle years with pale-bronze skin, a stern hawk-nosed patrician face and short cropped greying hair, wearing a plain undyed white Roman governor's toga over a tunic (an equestrian prefect — NO senatorial purple stripe), an official ring on his hand, standing in cold imperial authority
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
